The hole drilled for my ignition switch is probably an 1/8th of an inch too big (I was using a step drill bit), and the ignition switch has a notch on the top to keep it from spinning when you turn the key- so currently the ignition switch can freely rotate.

Basically I need ideas on how to reduce the size of the ~1" hole. First I tried to fill the bottom of the hole with some solder but that did not work.
